name: All Your Base

reasons.text: HONEYPOT SIGNAL: a simulated buy worked but selling back failed (reverted: balance).
Addresses can be blocked: setBlacklist(address,bool), setBlacklistBatch(address[],bool).
Upgradeable proxy (EIP-1967): the code can be replaced.
Brand new: contract creation (on-chain) 1 h ago.
Top 10 holders own 0.3% (estimate excluding pools and burn).

limits: Sell simulation runs in one block from a contract address: tokens that block contracts, enforce cooldowns or change rules later can behave differently for a real wallet.
Uniswap v4 hooks can charge fees or change behavior per swap; the simulation reflects the hook at the time of the check.
Owner powers come from the verified ABI or, if unverified, from function selectors in the bytecode: renamed or hidden functions can be missed.
LP lock status is only verified for burned LP tokens on v2-style pools; third-party lockers and concentrated-liquidity positions are not checked.
Holder concentration comes from GeckoTerminal snapshots and can include pools, lockers and exchanges.
disclaimer: Automated, informational risk signals from public on-chain and market data at the time of the check. Not financial advice, not an audit, no guarantee: a token that passes can still lose value or be changed later by whoever controls it.
